subject: cli-exit-codes
text: - Exit 0 under `--json`: `viola link`'s document is `{"v":1,"ok":{"since":<ts>,"already_linked":<bool>}}`, `<ts>` the time the wrapper recorded the link, and `viola unlink`'s is `{"v":1,"ok":{}}`.

subject: cli-exit-codes
text: - Exit 20 is also reached by `viola link` / `viola unlink` on a pair the wrapper refuses (`-32602`; a `driver` equal to `driven`, which the CLI never refuses itself): `error: wrapper fault  <code>`, or under `--json` the `wrapper-fault` document.

subject: cli-exit-codes
text: - Exit 21's server-verification cause is built for `send`, `wait`, `last`, `answer`, `pause`, `release`, `link` and `unlink`: a process on the endpoint that is not the recorded wrapper (its pid or start time differs, or the check cannot be made) gets no frame, and the verb prints `unable  <name>  instance-unreachable` with the server-verification hint last on stderr, or under `--json` the document `{"v":1,"error":"instance-unreachable","detail":null}` with stderr empty.

subject: cli-help
text: - `viola --help` groups verbs as `board: list` / `traffic: send, wait, last, answer` / `wheel: pause, release` / `handoff: link, unlink` / `setup: run, revive, verify, plugin install` (`revive` beside `run`: the operator's answer at the chunk 2026-10-10-viola-revive wrap). As built (chunk 2026-10-17-cli-output-discipline) it lists the served verbs only: `board: list` / `traffic: send, wait, last, answer` / `wheel: pause, release` / `handoff: link, unlink` / `setup: run, revive, verify, plugin install`, then `Options:`.
